method_card.title: School Subjects and the School Day
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school subject vocabulary, giving opinions with reasons, telling the time, and describing your timetable.

FrenchEnglish
le françaisFrench
les mathsmaths
les sciencesscience
l'histoirehistory
la géographiegeography
l'informatiquecomputer science
la musiquemusic
l'EPSPE
le dessin / l'artart
intéressant(e)interesting
ennuyeux / ennuyeuseboring
utileuseful
difficiledifficult
facileeasy
passionnant(e) (Higher)exciting / fascinating
l'emploi du tempstimetable

Opinions with reasons: Use Ma matière préférée, c'est… + parce que or car + reason. Je suis fort(e) en… = I am good at. Je suis nul(le) en… = I am rubbish at. These opinion structures earn marks in speaking and writing tasks.

Telling the time: Il est huit heures (8:00), et quart (quarter past), et demie (half past), moins le quart (quarter to). À midi = at noon. Timetables use 24-hour time in France: Il est treize heures (1 pm).

Adjective agreement: Adjectives must agree with the noun: les leçons intéressantes (f pl), le cours ennuyeux (m sg). Watch the feminine: ennuyeux → ennuyeuse, passionnant → passionnante.

Model: Ma matière préférée, c'est les sciences parce que je trouve les cours passionnants. Cependant, je suis nulle en maths car c'est trop difficile pour moi. Le lundi, les leçons commencent à huit heures trente. (My favourite subject is science because I find the lessons exciting. However, I am rubbish at maths because it is too difficult for me. On Mondays, lessons start at 8:30.)

method_card.title: School Life, Rules and Issues
method_card.content:
This lesson covers school facilities, rules, uniform and school issues including bullying and exam stress.

FrenchEnglish
la bibliothèquelibrary
la cantinecanteen
la cour (de récréation)playground / courtyard
la salle de classeclassroom
le terrain de sportsports field
le gymnasegym
on doityou must / we must
il est interdit deit is forbidden to
on ne peut pasyou cannot
l'uniformeuniform
le harcèlementbullying
le stressstress
la pressionpressure
réussirto succeed / to pass
échouerto fail
le brevet (Higher)GCSE-equivalent qualification

Expressing rules: Three key structures: Il faut + infinitive = you must; On doit + infinitive = you must; Il est interdit de + infinitive = it is forbidden to. After a negative, the indefinite/partitive article becomes de: il n'y a pas de piscine.

School issues: Le harcèlement = bullying; le stress des examens = exam stress; la pression = pressure. Use à cause de (because of) or à mon avis (in my opinion) to build arguments.

Model: Dans mon collège, il y a une grande bibliothèque et une cantine. On doit porter un uniforme et il est interdit d'utiliser son portable en classe. À mon avis, le harcèlement est un problème sérieux dans beaucoup d'écoles. (In my school, there is a large library and a canteen. You must wear a uniform and it is forbidden to use your phone in class. In my opinion, bullying is a serious problem in many schools.)

method_card.title: Jobs and Work Experience
method_card.content:
This lesson covers job title vocabulary, work experience, and giving opinions about future work.

FrenchEnglish
un médecindoctor
un(e) infirmier / infirmièrenurse
un(e) professeur(e)teacher
un(e) avocat(e)lawyer
un(e) ingénieur(e)engineer
un(e) coiffeur / coiffeusehairdresser
un(e) vendeur / vendeusesales assistant
un(e) cuisinier / cuisinièrechef / cook
un stagework placement
le patron / la patronneboss
un(e) collèguecolleague
une entreprisecompany
le salairesalary
bien payé(e) (Higher)well paid

Feminine job titles: Key patterns to know — -eur → -euse (coiffeur → coiffeuse, vendeur → vendeuse), -ier → -ière (infirmier → infirmière, cuisinier → cuisinière), -teur → -trice (acteur → actrice). Some don't change: un/une médecin, un/une journaliste.

Talking about work experience (perfect tense): J'ai fait un stage dans… (I did a work placement in…). J'ai aidé les clients (I helped customers). J'ai appris beaucoup de choses (I learnt a lot of things). C'était une bonne expérience (It was a good experience — imperfect).

Model: J'ai fait un stage dans un magasin pendant une semaine. Mon patron était sympa et mes collègues étaient accueillants. J'ai appris beaucoup de choses utiles. À l'avenir, je voudrais devenir infirmière parce que j'aime aider les gens. (I did a work placement in a shop for a week. My boss was nice and my colleagues were welcoming. I learnt many useful things. In the future, I would like to become a nurse because I like helping people.)

exam_context.frequency: Very common in extended writing and speaking tasks about future plans

method_card.title: Future Plans and Career Aspirations
method_card.content:
This lesson covers post-16 plans, university, apprenticeships and careers using the conditional and future tense.

FrenchEnglish
le lycéesixth-form / upper secondary school
l'université / la facuniversity
l'apprentissageapprenticeship
le bacbaccalaureate (French qualification, like A-levels)
le bac provocational baccalaureate
quitter l'écoleto leave school
continuer mes étudesto continue my studies
travailler à plein tempsto work full-time
voyagerto travel
l'année sabbatiquegap year
je voudrais / j'aimeraisI would like (conditional)
je vais + infinitiveI am going to (near future)
je ferai / j'irai / je seraiI will do / I will go / I will be (simple future)
si je réussis (Higher)if I pass / if I succeed

Three future structures — use all three for maximum marks:

  • Near future: je vais étudier au lycée (I am going to study at sixth form)
  • Conditional: je voudrais aller à l'université (I would like to go to university)
  • Simple future: je travaillerai comme ingénieur(e) (I will work as an engineer)

Post-16 pathways (UK and French systems): In the UK students may go to sixth form, college, or take an apprenticeship. In France, students study for the bac (general) or bac pro (vocational) before going to l'université (also called la fac informally). An apprentissage (alternance) combines work and study.

Model: Après le brevet, je vais continuer mes études au lycée. J'aimerais passer le bac et ensuite aller à l'université pour étudier la médecine. Si je réussis mes examens, je deviendrai médecin. (After my exams, I am going to continue studying at sixth form. I would like to sit my bac and then go to university to study medicine. If I pass my exams, I will become a doctor.)

exam_context.frequency: Very high frequency — future plans appear in extended writing, speaking picture tasks and conversation

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Je vais étudier = I am going to study (near future: aller + infinitive). Describes an imminent or planned action.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Je voudrais étudier = I would like to study (conditional of vouloir). Describes a wish or preference.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: J'étudierai = I will study (simple future). Describes a definite future action. Regular -er verbs add endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont to the infinitive.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Use all three in your writing for variety: je vais (going to), je voudrais (would like), j'étudierai (will study).

worked_examples.question: What is the difference between je vais étudier, je voudrais étudier, and j'étudierai?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Take the infinitive: travailler. Add future endings: -ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: Result: je travaillerai, tu travailleras, il/elle travaillera.

steps.label: Step 3
steps.content: Irregular future stems to know: aller → ir- (j'irai), être → ser- (je serai), avoir → aur- (j'aurai), faire → fer- (je ferai), vouloir → voudr- (je voudrai).

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Regular -er verbs: infinitive + future ending (-ai, -as, -a…). Irregular stems: ir- (aller), ser- (être), fer- (faire), aur- (avoir).

worked_examples.question: How do you form the simple future tense for regular -er verbs?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: In French, after si (if) meaning 'if this happens', use the present tense (not future).

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: The result clause (the 'then' part) uses the future tense: Si je réussis (present) mes examens, je serai (future) médecin.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Si + present tense → result in future: Si je travaille dur, je réussirai. (If I work hard, I will succeed.)
